course_name_th: การวิเคราะห์ตัวแบบเชิงคณิตศาสตร์

modules.title: Modeling Foundations
modules.summary: Orient the course around what mathematical models are, why they matter, and how modeling work begins.

modules.title: Modeling Tools and Techniques
modules.summary: Use foundational mathematical and statistical tools to set up and compare modeling choices.

modules.title: Linear and Nonlinear Models
modules.summary: Compare model structures and decide when a linear or nonlinear view is more useful.

modules.title: Model Development and Probability Models
modules.summary: Move from structure choice into full model development and probabilistic perspectives.

modules.title: Validation and Advanced Cases
modules.summary: Test model validity, inspect advanced examples, and discuss ethical handling of modeling decisions.

modules.title: Project Modeling Studio
modules.summary: Use project-based work, peer critique, and final presentation as the capstone modeling experience.

clos.label: Explain mathematical and statistical techniques used in mathematical modeling.
Search and review modeling work connected to real-world problems.
Integrate knowledge from other areas to create more complete mathematical models.
Build mathematical models that are analyzed, tested, and checked for validity.
Apply models to real-world problems and interpret results effectively.
Demonstrate ethics in the development and analysis of mathematical models.
